extra_context: We're a small farm-to-table spot in the Hudson Valley, run by me and my wife Dana. The menu changes every few weeks depending on what our growers pull out of the ground, so you'll never see the exact same plate twice. We cook for folks who want a slow, unhurried dinner that feels like eating at a friend's farmhouse table, not a fancy night out. The one thing people always remember: every dish on the menu lists the farm it came from by name, and most of those farms are within 30 miles of our front door. Warm lighting, real candles, food that tastes like the season it's in.
